authored.form: When + present simple, I'll + base verb

authored.explanation_ar: نربط فعلًا مستقبلًا متوقع الحدوث بنتيجته؛ بعد when الزمن للمستقبل يكون غالبًا المضارع لا will.
authored.explanation_en: Use when followed by the simple present for an expected future time, and will in the main clause.
authored.contrast_ar: When I get home, I'll call = عند الوصول المتوقع؛ If I get home early = شرط.
authored.contrast_en: When treats the future event as expected. Use the present simple in the future time-clause; if presents a condition rather than an assumed future time.

advanced.prompt:
عدّل العبارة لتوافق البناء المستهدف في هذا التمرين:
When I will know the final date, I'll update the calendar.
options: When I will know the final date, I'll update the calendar.
When I know the final date, I'll update the calendar.
advanced.answer: When I know the final date, I'll update the calendar.
advanced.explanation_ar: When I get home, I'll call = عند الوصول المتوقع؛ If I get home early = شرط.
advanced.explanation_en: When treats the future event as expected. Use the present simple in the future time-clause; if presents a condition rather than an assumed future time.
